data.one_liner: Widget that shows builder or fallback based on a boolean condition
data.what_it_does: ConditionalBuilder displays a builder widget when the condition is true and a fallback widget when it is false. If fallback is null, it returns an empty container.
use_when: When you need to show different UI based on a simple boolean condition
When you want a quick way to toggle between two widgets without writing if/else logic
avoid_when: When the condition depends on complex state that should be managed by a state management solution
When you need animations or transitions between the two widgets
weaknesses: No documentation on performance or edge cases
data.minimal_example:
```dart
ConditionalBuilder(
  condition: true,
  builder: (context) => Center(child: Text('this is true')),
  fallback: (context) => Center(child: Text('this is not true')),
)
```
